column4: Metamorphosis now offers the matching talent position from all five other classes instead of random alternatives.
Talent details show their source class, and already-owned alternatives remain visible with replacement disabled.
Added class-position, point-transfer, duplicate, alias, save and native-touch checks with chooser screenshots.
Recorded reviewed statistics components and the remaining review scope; the whole-system audit is still in progress.
Recorded TEST106's actual delivery and the next build's changes, checks and compatibility limits.
I replaced random metamorphosis alternatives with the matching position from every other class. Existing points and duplicate protection stay intact, and each choice names its source class.
